subject: Queja: ruidos de la terraza hasta las 3 de la madrugada

triage.summary: Resident complains about loud music from a nearby bar terrace lasting until 3 AM on weekends and asks the neighborhood association to intervene.
triage.proposed_action: Forward complaint to the association board for review and possible action against the bar (e.g., formal letter or contact with local authorities).
